notes: Variant assumption is a standing bilateral cable chest fly or cable crossover using dual cable handles. Visible roles are conservative: Pectoralis major primary from direct cable-crossover pectoralis EMG, Anterior deltoid secondary from close fly-pattern EMG. Biceps brachii was not shown because stronger biceps evidence comes from dumbbell flyes with independent free weights. Serratus anterior, rotator cuff, and trunk stabilizers were not shown because exact cable-fly evidence did not justify a concise app-facing support role. Main uncertainty is variation: high-to-low, mid-height, low-to-high, seated, and one-arm cable flys can change line of pull and shoulder demands.
